title: Unraveling the degradation mechanism of sodium iron hexacyanoferrate cathodes in sodium ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02117K, Paper
Junyi Dai, Jiahao Li, Fangxin Ling, Yu Yao, Yanru Wang, Mingze Ma, Jian Feng, Jun Xia, Yinbo Zhu, Hai Yang, Xianhong Rui, Hengan Wu, Yan Yu
Fe(CN)64− vacancies in Prussian blue analog cathodes hinder Na+ transport and trigger side reactions, causing capacity loss. High-quality PBA with fewer defects mitigates this, achieving 81.7% capacity retention over 900 cycles.
